_notes: Test version of the train scene's opening thought. The real one, ch01_train_thought, arrives in Milestone 6 part C. James thinks about what Kessler said (her voice is a memory, so it has a name and no face).

lines.speaker: james
lines.text: The box hasn't moved off my knees since Kingsport. Her voice hasn't left my head either.

lines.name: Kessler
lines.text: It's a box, Flint. You carry it over the pass, you hand it to the county clerk, you come home. Try not to solve anything.

lines.speaker: james
lines.text: Try not to solve anything. Two months a detective. Two months of carrying boxes. At this rate I'll make inspector by the time I'm a hundred and four.
